hero.badge: The reward goes to the person who refers you
hero.headline: Three paths, on every order.
hero.subline1: Enter one personal code and pay full price, leave the field empty, or use discount codes.
hero.subline2: The buyer does not receive a reward.
hero.microcopy: Become a customer with a single purchase of any amount. You always pay 100% of the published price.

how_it_works.title: How It Works
how_it_works.step1_desc: For each cart you name a referrer, no code, or discount codes.
how_it_works.step2_desc: You pay the published price, with a discount only when a code covers that line.
how_it_works.step3_desc: The personal code applies to that order only.
how_it_works.step4_desc: One code per line, from 3% to 13%.

referral_highlight.title: Reward for the referrer
referral_highlight.desc: Credit does not go to the buyer. One personal code per order. Self-referral is blocked.

cta_grid.referral: Invite friends with your unique link

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.body: On each cart you choose a referrer, no benefit, or discount codes.

cashback.title: How the reward works
cashback.info_desc: A personal code keeps the full price and pays the referrer. An empty field keeps the same amount in the internal budget. Discount codes lower the price and set both reward and internal quota to zero for the whole order.

referral.title: Personal code
referral.desc: The code is chosen per order. It does not create a permanent link.

charity.title: Charity & Transparency
charity.desc: Every month we donate 1% of total revenue to the "Il Segreto di Aladino" Association
